dhcp_range.description: DHCP range (e.g., '192.168.0.100,192.168.0.120') for thin clients. Leave empty to use dnsmasq defaults.

dhcp_boot.description: Custom PXE boot filename (e.g., 'ltsp/amd64/pxelinux.0'). Usually auto-detected.

nbd_root.description: Absolute path to the NBD-exported root filesystem image. Overrides the default image path.

nbd_enabled.description: Enable NBD (Network Block Device) instead of NFS for root filesystem delivery.

nbd_https.description: Use HTTPS for NBD traffic (requires TLS certificates and compatible NBD server).

base_image.description: Path to the base root filesystem (e.g., '/opt/ltsp/amd64'). Defaults to architecture-specific path.

kernel_options.description: Additional kernel command-line parameters applied to all thin clients (e.g., 'quiet splash vga=791').

persistent_home.description: Enable persistent home directories for users by mounting NFS shares.

persistent_home_nfs.description: NFS export path (e.g., '/export/ltsp/homes') for persistent home directories.

ldm_language.description: Default language/locale for LDM (LTSP Display Manager) login screen (e.g., 'en_US.UTF-8').

ldm_sound.description: Enable audio redirection via PulseAudio for thin clients.

dns_servers.description: List of DNS servers to provide to thin clients (e.g., ['8.8.8.8', '1.1.1.1']).

ntp_servers.description: List of NTP servers for time synchronization on thin clients.

extra_packages.description: Extra Debian packages to install during LTSP image build (e.g., ['vim', 'htop', 'firefox']).

client_sshd.description: Enable the SSH daemon in the client image, allowing remote SSH access to thin clients.

ldm_greeter.description: GNOME Display Manager greeter or alternative (e.g., 'gdm3', 'lightdm').

ip.description: Static IP address for this client (e.g., '192.168.0.110').

root.description: Override root path (NFS export) for this client only.

nbd_root.description: Override NBD root path for this client only.

clients.description: List of client-specific configuration overrides (by MAC address).
